sanskrit: namāmi devīṃ varadāṃ sarasvatīm tantrāṇāmudbhavaṃ kiñcit tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho tanoti vipulānarthān tattvamantrasamāśritān kāmikaṃ yogajaṃ cintyaṃ kāraṇaṃ tvajitaṃ tathā vijayaṃ caiva niśvāsaṃ syāyaṃbhuvamathānilam candrajñānaṃ ca bimbaṃ ca prodgītaṃ lalitaṃ tathā kiraṇaṃ vātulaṃ caiva aṣṭāviṃśatisaṃhitā * * * caiva viprendra trividhaṃ bhedamucyate cityaṃ ca ṣaḍvidhaṃ proktaṃ saptadhā kāraṇaṃ bhavet dīptaṃ caiva tu viprendra navadhā bhedamucyate aṃśumān dvādaśaṃ bhedaṃ procyate kamalāsana śivabhedaṃ mayā proktaṃ upabhedaṃ śrṛṇuṣvathā niśvāsaṃ ca viśeṣeṇa aṣṭadhā bhedamucyate āgneyamekarudraṃ tu bhedamanyanna vidyate rauravaṃ ṣaṭsu bhedena procyate kamalāsana vimalākhyaṃ mahātantraṃ caturdaśavidhaṃ bhavet mukhaṃ vipraṃ ca viprendra bhedapañcadaśa bhavet lalitākhyaṃ mahātantraṃ tridhā bhedena cocyate santānākhyaṃ mahātantraṃ saptabhedena cocyate pārameśvaratantraṃ tu saptabhedena vakṣyate vimalākhyaṃ mahātantraṃ bhedaṃ dvādaśamucyate dvihastau ca dvipādau ca ṛtvā vāta sthitaṃ bhavet śuklavastraparīdhānaṃ yajñopavītasaṃyutam padmamadhye sthi(taṃ) daivaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam pustakasya pramāṇaṃ ca śrṛṇuṣva kamalāsana

aṣṭādaśā"ngulaṃ vāpi navadaśā"ngulaṃ tu vā dvāviṃśatirvā viprendra kārayet deśikottamaḥ utsedhaṃ cāṣṭadhā hitvā ekāṃśaṃ caiva vistaram tribhāgaṃ tu caturbhāgaṃ madhye suṣuramucyate labdhauccaṃ caiva viprendra mānā"ngulana bhājayet samaṃ cet tatparigrāhyamāyavyayamihocyate śeṣamāyamidaṃ proktaṃ guṇenaiva vivardhayet padaṃ prati gaṇairvṛddhiraṣṭabhirgrāsayettataḥ saptaviṃśatibhirgrāsaṃ labdhamiṣṭamiti smṛtam triṃśadbhirhāsayoktāni śeṣaṃ sthitirihocyate śeṣaṃ vāramiti proktaṃ āyavyaya cayeti ca āyādhikaṃ vyayaṃ hīnaṃ saṃpatkaramihocyate tasmātsarvaprayatnena āyahīnanna kārayet dhūmraśca gardabhaḥ kāko doṣāṇyetāni varjayet evaṃ parīkṣya bahudhā kartavyaṃ pustakaṃ param viśvāmitro'tha bālmīkiḥ kāśyapāṃścā"ngirastathā caturdaśā"ngulādīni kramādvinyasya deśikaḥ gati catvāridaścaiva kati catvārireva ca brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca īśvaraśśiva eva ca * * * śāṃgulādīni vedanāmiha cocyate ṣaṭpatirvātha pañcairvā lekhayet pustakaṃ tataḥ pa"nktirevaṃ samākhyātaṃ tattannāmnādhidaivataḥ ṛṣīṇaṃ bhujapatre tu lekhayettu dvijottamaḥ dvau pārśve kaḥ pa * * * pustakāyāma tatsamam śivāgre maṇṭapaṃ kuryādīśāne dakṣiṇe'pi vā

vedi bāhye tu paritaḥ parivārāni kārayet sthaṇḍilaṃ vā prakartavyaṃ lakṣaṇena samanvitam athā"nkurārpaṇaṃ kuryāt pañcāhe saptake'pi vā sahiraṇyaṃ sakūrcaṃ ca somarājādhidevatam vinyasettu viśeṣeṇa pālikā aṣṭadikṣu vai puṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra pavamānena prokṣayet elālava"ngatakkolamuśīraṃ candanairyutam śālinā vikaredveti padmamaṣṭadalaṃ likhet pañcadhā śayanaṃ kalpya śāyayet pustakaṃ tathā hrasva brahma samākhyātaṃ dīrghā"ngāni na cocyate brahmama"ngamiha proktaṃ sarveṣāṃ ca vidhīyate darpaṇaṃ caiva viprendra evameva krameṇa tu pustakasyendra digbhāge vinyasetkumbhameva ca sarvatra sahiraṇyaṃ ca sarasvatīṃ nyasettataḥ pūrvādīśānaparyantaṃ vinyasedvardhanīṣu ca ? sarvabhūtamanonmanīm hṛdayādi ṣaḍa"ngaiśca pūjayettu vidhānataḥ pālāśaṃ pūrvato bhāge aśvatthaṃ dakṣiṇe tathā audumbaraṃ tathaiśānyaṃ pālāśairvāpi homayet samidhā sadyamantreṇa īśānenājya homayet sarṣapaṃ sadyamantreṇa netreṇa tu yavāṃstathā sahasraṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vāpi hūyate dravyānte vyāhṛtiṃ hutvā pustakaṃ sparśayeddhṛdā sviṣṭamagneti mantreṇa juhuyāttadanantaram tattāgamaṃ ca bījena prokṣayedvardhanīṃ tataḥ

havirnivedayet paścāt tāmbūlaṃ dāpayettataḥ brāhmaṇān bhojayettatra saptakanyāṃśca pūjayet kapālaṃ pāñcarātraṃ ca ṣaḍaite samayā smṛtāḥ mantrasaṃkaradoṣeṇa rājā rāṣṭraṃ vinaśyati aṣṭāviṃśati bhedena śaivabhedaṃ vidhīyate dīkṣitasya sudhīrasya śivabhaktiparasya ca adīkṣitaṃ tat srota syānna deyaṃ yasya kasyacit tantrāvatāramevoktaṃ pañcākṣaravidhiṃ śṛṇu śrīpañcākṣarakalpaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ vada me prabho namaskāreṇa saṃyuktaṃ śiva ityakṣaradvayam tadvargāntaṃ saptamaṃ syāt pañcākṣaramiti smṛtam yakāreṇa samāyuktaṃ pañcākṣaramihocyate ṛgvedājjāyate vipra nakārākṣaramucyate atharveda tu vakāraṃ yakāramitihāsake sāvitrīchandasā yuktaṃ gatamena samāyutam makāraṃ pītavarṇaṃ tu brahmāṇa trādhidaivatam triṣṭupchandassamāyuktaṃ viśvāmitrasamanvitam vakāraṃ raktavarṇaṃ tu skandastatrādhidaivatam sthānaṃ aghoravaktraṃ syāt śikārākṣaramucyate puruṣasya mukhaṃ sthānaṃ vakārākṣara kīrtitam sāvitrīchandasāyuktaṃ bhāradvājena saṃyutam pañcākṣaramiha proktaṃ śṛṇu tatvākṣaratvataḥ akāraṃ brahmadaivatyaṃ ukāraṃ viṣṇudaivatam ṛgvedaṃ tu akārassyāt yujurvedaṃ makārakam akāraṃ sātvikaṃ vidyādukāraṃ rājasaṃ bhavet

ikāraṃ pauṣṭikaṃ vidyāt akāraṃ mābhicārakam makāraṃ pītavarṇaṃ syāt devamevaṃ krameṇa tu oṃkāreṇa samāyuktaṃ ṣaḍakṣaramihocyate a"ngulyāṃ tu japedekaṃ pañcāyāmramayaṃ bhavet śataśayaistu vijñeyaṃ pravālaṃ tu sahasrakam padmākṣaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ sauvarṇaṃ daśakoṭikam nyāsaṃ kuryāttato mantrī pañcākṣaramihocyate kaniṣṭhādya"ngulānāṃ tu saṃhāranyāsamucyate karanyāsaṃ purā kṛtvā a"nganyāsamatha śṛṇu śakāraṃ kaṇṭhadeśe tu makāraṃ hṛdaye nyaset sarvā"ngeṣu ca viprendra oṃkāraṃ vinyasettataḥ pañcāśat pañcaviṃśairvā japaṃ kuryādviśeṣataḥ japaṃ kuryāttu viprendra praṇavena samāyutam nadītīre śataṃ vidyāt sahasraṃ devatālaye lakṣalakṣaṃ tatā japtvā raudraṃ padamavāpnuyāt śrīpañcākṣaramevoktaṃ mantroddhāraṇa śṛṇuṣvatha sarvapāpaviśuddhyarthaṃ mantroddhāraṃ kathaṃ bhavet mananaṃ sarvavaktrāṇāṃ trāṇaṃ saṃsārasāgarāt ga"ngākūle samudre vā prāsāde vā viśeṣataḥ anyeṣu śuddhadeśeṣu mantramuddhārayetkramāt pūrvarātrādhivāsaṃ ca prabhāte mantramuddharet śivatattve pare sūkṣme bindurutpadyate tathā śaktestu vāk bhavannādaṃ vāk bhavāt ṣoḍaśā kalāt śāntaṃ sarvagataṃ śūnyaṃ śivarūpamiti bruvan tavargaṃ ca pavargaṃ ca yavargaṃ ca śavargakam

varjayeccaiva viprendra avargaṃ ca daśākṣaram hrasva brahma samākhyātaṃ dīrghā"ngāni ca cocyate japāpuṣpanibhaṃ vāmamaghoramañjanaprabham brahmavarṇa samākhyātaṃ tadrūpaṃ vakṣate'dhunā dvipādāṃ ca dvihastāṃ ca pañcabrahmamihocyate śikhā kavaca netraṃ ca astramantreṇa saṃyutam ravinibha yugāntāni saṃprāpyaṃ tu pitāmahā dvinetrāṃ ca dvihastāṃ ca dvipādena samanvitām śuklavastrasamāyuktāṃ ṣaḍa"ngānāmihocyate japākusumasaṃkāśaṃ kundapuṣpanibhaṃ bhavet nīlajīmūtasaprakhyaṃ ku"nkumaṃ brahmameva ca vidyeśvarāṇāṃ varṇaṃ ca tava snehāt prakāśitaḥ aṣṭavargaṃ tṛtīyaṃ tu ṣaṣṭhasvarasamanvitam ādivargaṃ tṛtīyaṃ tu bindunādasamanvitam prathamasya dvitīyaṃ tu bindunādasamanvitam gaṇāmbikā ca caṇḍeśo nandīśaśca tathaiva ca bhṛ"ngīśaśca mahāsena svanāmādyakṣarairyutam vāyussomastathaiśānaḥ bahmā viṣṇuśca saṃyutam vajraṃ śaktiṃ ca daṇḍaṃ ca khaḍgaṃ pāśaṃ tathā"nkuśam svanāmādyena bījena bindunādasamanvitam śrīvatsaṃ svastikaṃ śa"nkhaṃ dīpo devāṣṭama"ngalam ṣaṣṭhavargāt dvitīyaṃ tu caturthyādyena saṃyutam visargeṇa samāyuktaṃ pāśupadāstramucyate bhūtānāṃ piśācānāṃ gandharvā yakṣakinnarāḥ svanāmadyakṣaraṃ vipra bindunādasamanvitam

mūrttipānāṃ ca śiṣyāṇāmevameva krameṇa tu yakārādi dvayaṃ vargaṃ catvāryakṣaramucyate anantāsanaṃ tu viprendra yogāsanaṃ tathaiva ca vimalāsanaṃ tu viprendra svanāmādyakṣarairyutam āgneyamaṇḍalaṃ caiva vinyasettu viśeṣataḥ tato maṇḍalamevoktaṃ svanāmādyakṣarairyutam vyomavyāpimahāmantra ṣaṇṇavatyakṣarairyutam dvādaśārasya padmasya bahissyādvividhā punaḥ mantramuddharate vipra sarvakāmamavāpnuyāt śivaviṣṇusamārūḍhaṃ śivamantramihocyate vyomarūpāśca pañcaiva rūpā yaścata eva ca taccayaṃ caiva ghnāyaśca vṛśca yaśca bhramaṃ ca ca daśca pāśca vineraśca meśca bhiśca na yeva ca evaṃ krameṇa viprendra vinyasedastramantravit niśca taśca dhipaścaiva kūrmarājagatāśca tā vyomaśca ścaiva ye yo śca o mi ca śca ya eva ca vaśca oṃ bhūśca aśceti niśca vā ya ni ni śca ca evaṃ krameṇa vinyāsaṃ sarvakāmamavāpnuyāt agastyena samāyuktaṃ jagati cchandasaṃyutam vasiṣṭhena samāyuktaṃ prakṛticchandasaṃyutam ācāryasya ca bījaṃ ca ṛṣichando'dhidevatāḥ atrīyaśca samāyuktaṃ pañcavaktreṣu dīkṣitāḥ jagadī śakvarī caiva anuṣṭup tṛṣṭupeva ca āgamasyaiva bījāni pravakṣyāmyanupūrvaśaḥ bindunādasamāyuktaṃ kāmikākṣaramucyate

saptamena ca saṃyuktaṃ ekādaśa samanvitam tṛtīyasyādimaṃ grāhya saptamasya dvitīyakam cintyākṣaramidaṃ proktaṃ dvitīyasyādisaṃyutam kāraṇākhyamidaṃ proktaṃ prathamasyādisaṃyutam bindunādasamāyuktamajitaṃ tviha cocyate dvādaśākṣarasaṃyuktaṃ bindunādasamanvitam dvādaśākṣarasaṃyuktaṃ bindunādasamanvitam saptamasya dvitīyaṃ tu māyābījena saṃyutam antyākṣarasamāyuktaṃ bindunādasamanvitam tṛtīyasvarasaṃyuktaṃ bindunādasamanvitam māyālepasamāyuktaṃ bindunādasamanvitam saptamasya caturthaṃ tu māyābījasamanvitam antyākṣaramiti proktaṃ dvitīyasvarabhūṣitam saptamasyādimaṃ bījaṃ māyānalasamanvitam saptamasya dvitīyaṃ tu dvādaśasvarabhūṣitam akṣarāṇāṃ paraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ rauravaṃ procyate mayā māyānalasamāyuktaṃ makuṭākṣaramucyate bindunādasamāyuktaṃ vimalaṃ caiva kathyate bindunādasamāyuktaṃ candrajñānamihocyate bindunādasamāyuktaṃ bimbasyākṣaramucyate bindunādasamāyuktaṃ protgītamiha cocyate bindunādasamāyuktaṃ lalitasvara bhūṣitam analena samāyuktaṃ siddhāṃ tantramihocyate saptamasya dvitīyena bindunāda samanvitam dvādaśasvarasaṃyuktaṃ bindunādasamanvitam

māyānalasamāyuktaṃ bindunādasamanvitam dvādaśasvarasaṃyuktaṃ bindunādasamanvitam māyānalasamāyuktaṃ bindunādasamanvitam chandadaivatānvakṣye āgamānāṃ viśeṣataḥ tava rūpeṇa saṃyuktaṃ kāmikādīni sapta ca ajitaśchandasaṃyuktaṃ viṣṇustatrādhidaivatam adīkṣitairna śrotavyaṃ na deyaṃ na prakāśitam aṣṭavargāttṛtīyāntaṃ ādyakṣarasamāyutam śaktibījamidaṃ proktaṃ sarvakāmārthasādhanam śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ tryakṣaṃ daśabhujairyutam divyāmbaradharaṃ devaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam pāśaṃ cā"nkuśa ghaṇṭā ca nāgaṃ vahniṃśca vāmake etatsakalamākhyātaṃ dharmakāmārthamokṣadam viśeṣaṃ śrotumicchāmi taṃ me brūhi maheśvara ayogyaṃ hi ca puṣpāṇāṃ tāvacchṛṇu tapodhana karavīra sahasrebhyaḥ bilvapatra viśiṣyate padmapuṣpasahasrebhyaḥ puṇḍarīkaṃ viśiṣyate śatapatrasahasreṇa * srakarṇaṃ viśiṣyate bakapuṣpasahasrebhyaḥ dhūddhūrakaṃ viśiṣyate droṇapuṣpa sahasrebhyaḥ apamārgaṃ viśiṣyate kuśapuṣpa sahasrebhyaḥ śamīpuṣpaṃ viśiṣyate vyāghātānāṃ sahasrebhyo śa"nkhapuṣpaṃ viśiṣyate vyāghrapuṣpa sahasrebhyo sadābhadraṃ viśiṣyate bṛhaddroṇaviśiṣṭebhyaḥ nīlotpalaṃ viśiṣyate prakṣālya pañcagavyena nīlotpalaṃ tu kāñcanam

japāpuṣpakadambaṃ ca punnāgaṃ ca tathaiva ca aṃjayaṃ mallikā jājī jātī javantireva ca bilvapatrasamaṃ jñeyaṃ punnāgaṃ ca viśiṣyate padmapuṣpasamaṃ jñeyaṃ vakulaṃ parameva ca śvetaṃ kusumaṃ raktotpalamapāmārga samaṃ bhavet gandhapuṣpaṃ gaṇḍapuṣpaṃ padmapuṣpasamaṃ bhavet koraṇḍakasya puṣpaṃ ca apāmārgasamaṃ bhavet sūryavarttā nāga * * * * ñca śa"nkhameva ca vajraṃ ca padmarāgaṃ ca marakataṃ mauktikāni ca nīlotpalasamaṃ jñeyaṃ sarvaratnāni caiva hi aṃkolaṃ sakaraṃ caiva priya"ngu jambu caiva ca palāśapuṣpaṃ viprendra raviraśmisamāyutam yavagodhūmanīvāra vrīhi vaiṇavakāni ca a"nkurāṇi prakartavyaṃ pūjayecchivamādarāt kadambārjunasindūraṃ * * * kusumāni ca kadalīpuṣpapunnāganāganandī tathaiva ca giriyārkau girikarṇī ca dhūrddhūraka samaṃ bhavet puṣpāṇāmapyalabhettu phalānāṃ pūjayettataḥ mūlānāmapyalābhe tu bhaktyā caiva tu pūjayet ketakī mādhavī kundamadhudīmradayaṃtikā nīlakarṇakamevātha poṭakāmenvameva ca evameva krameṇaiva yo naraḥ pūjayet sadā puṣpādhyāyamidaṃ proktaṃ karṣaṇasya vidhiṃ śṛṇu etatsarvaṃ samāsena brūhi me parameśvara puṣyamāsādiṣāṇmāsaṃ devānāṃ tu divā bhavet

divāmāsaṃ ca gṛhṇīyāt rātrimāsaṃ ca varjayet ? maitryāditya maghāsyādivaṣṭādrāśravaṇāḥ śubhāḥ ? dvitīyāṃ tṛtīyāṃ pañcamī ṣaṣṭhī saptamī pratipatpūrṇamāvāsyāṃ kārayettu śivadvijaḥ somabhārgavasaumyāyāṃ vārā śreṣṭhatamā smṛtāḥ aṣṭamasthā grahāssarve sarvaṃ kurvanti dusthitam grahaṇe viṣuve caiva ayane vyatipātake evaṃ parīkṣya kartavyaṃ sarvasaṃpatkarāya ca ūṣaraṃ kṛmibhirjuṣṭaṃ valmīkāḍhyaṃ ta varjayet pītā vaiśyā iti proktā kṛṣṇā śūdrā iti smṛtāḥ adhikaṃ cottamaṃ jñeyamadhamaṃ nyūnameva ca kṣīravṛkṣayugaṃ badhvā gocarmeṇaiva baddhayet ācāryassakalīkṛtya navavastreṇa veṣṭayet ārādhya vṛṣabhaṃ tatra karṣayet śivamantrataḥ śālimudgakulasthaṃ ca bhūtale vinyasettataḥ teṣu pakṣeṣu kāleṣu gogaṇānāṃ nivedayet puṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra prokṣayet śivamantrataḥ vāstudehe'pi tatraiva śalyaṃ brūyādyathākramāt karasparśe gale tacca vṛddhasta trayamānataḥ hastamātre karasparśāt kha vā pādaṃ samādiśet pramāṇāpāde karṇā"ngamucyate kaṭasparśā tu lohaṃ ca karadvayapramāṇataḥ evaṃ parīkṣya bahudhā śalyamuddharate kramāt puṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra ṣaṇṇavatyā tu prokṣayet āyāmadvādaśā"ngulannāḍīṃ syāttu ṣaḍa"ngulam

sūtradvayaṃ tanaiva * * * * * * mānataḥ tatassūtradvayaṃ prāci pādayoścakramadhyame udāt sūtraṃ bhavettatra kṛtvā tu caturaśrakam vāstudevān samabhyarcya puruṣaṃ pūjayettataḥ ? mahattapa sasaṃ * * * * * bhūtakāṃ balaḥ evameva kramaṃ jñātvā vāstu tatraiva kalpayet brahmāṇaṃ pūrvato bhāge samayyaka tu ṣaṭpadam mitraścaiva tu viprendra paścime ṣaṭpadastathā āpaścaivāpavatsaśca aiśānyāṃ tu padadvaye indraścendrajayaścaiva nairṛtyāṃ tu padadvaye īśānaścaiva parjanyo jayantaśca mahendrakaḥ agniḥ pūṣā ca vitatho grahaḥ kraturyamastathā pitṛdauvārikaścaiva tathā sugrīvameva ca śoṣaśca pāpa yakṣmā ca paścime tu vyavasthi * bhalloṭaśca tathā somo ṛgoditi ditistathā vāstavānāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ brahmabhirmukha eva ca samānīya śiraṃ vidvān brahmakāyamihocyate evaṃ vāsturidaṃ proktaṃ caravāsa śṛṇuṣvatha mārgaśīrṣakamāsādi trayo māsāstu dakṣiṇe jyeṣṭhamāsādisaṃjñeyā uttare śīrṣaṃ tathā madhyarātrau tu viprendra paścime śira ucyate evaṃ puṣpaiśca dhūpaiśca dīpaiścaiva supūjayet sarveṣāṃ bali dātavya pāyasānnaṃ ghṛtaplutam tilamaṣṭānnasaṃyuktaṃ vivasvāti baliṃ tataḥ parjanye caiva sarpiśca jayante navanītakam

madhu citrodaraphalaṃ satye balimihocyate kṛsaraṃ yamadevaṃ tu gandharve khilamucyate dadhyānnaṃ ca mṛge dadyat pitṛpiṇḍākatailakam puṣpadante ja kusumaṃ pāyasaṃ varuṇe tathā ? rogobhi śuṣkamasyaṃ hi nāgau cārcaṃ baliṃ tathā bhalloṭe tu gulaṃ saṃ syāt some gulānnameva ca ditau ca tilabhakṣyeṇa kṣīrānnaṃ sarvarīśake savitā sāvitrake caiva ja"ngamaṃ dhodanaṃ tataḥ rudro rudrajaye caiva māsaṃ kṣīraṃ baliṃ dadet tilapiṣṭaṃ pūtanā caiva gulmāṣa pāparākṣasī devatānāmasaṃyuktaṃ caturthyantaṃ samāyutam ācāryairbali dātavyaṃ vāstuhomādikarmasu madhurā brahmaṇo bhūmiḥ karṣayā kṣatriyasya vai ājyagandhaṃ tu viprasya raktagandhā nṛpasya tu varṇagandharasānāṃ ca tattajjātyarhakaṃ bhavet adhikā cottamaṃ vidyāt madhyamā samapāṃsulā bhāsatkarā tuṣā keśā hastamuddharate tathā pañcaratna kṣipettatra ṣaṇṇavatyā ca mantritam darpaṇodarasaṃkāśa caturaśraṃ samantataḥ karṇasūtradvayopetaṃ tasyāgre mukhamucyate agniśca vitathaścaiva grahakṣata yamastathā roganāgaśca mukhyaśca . . . . momaścāditaro'pi ca vivasvān dakṣiṇaścaiva mitraścaiva tu paścime āpa vatsaśca sāvitrī indrajastaṃ tathaiva ca brahmaścatuṣpadaṃ bhu"nkte ṣaṭtriṃśatpadabhāginī

catuśśūle nyasettatra gandhapuṣpādinārcayet brahmakāyamiti proktaṃ vāmāmbāyavatsakeṃ rudre jayastathā caiva vāmabhāgaḥ prakīrtitaḥ mitraścaiva tu li"ngaṃ syādayomukhaṃ tu kārayet maṇḍalaṃ vardhayeddhīmān puṇyāhaṃ vācayettataḥ ekāṃśaṃ vartayettatra tattanmadhyādi bhrāmayet madhyāt karṇe parigṛhya tadardhenaiva bhrāmayet evameva krameṇaiva catvāro dalamucyate aṣṭābhirdalamevaṃ tu dalāgraṃ tatra yojayet a"ngulītrayakārye tu śobhāṃ caiva tu varjayet madhyātpūrvadalāntaṃ tu varttayetkesaraṃ tataḥ evameva krameṇaiva vartayenmaṇḍalaṃ tataḥ pūrvāgramuttarāgraṃ ca sūtradvayaṃ prasārayet sūtraprakārayormadhye śakraṃ tatraiva vinyaset madhūkaṃ devadāruṃ vā yājñikaṃ vṛkṣameva ca kartavyāccatura"ngulyaṃ kebarāśca ṣaḍa"ngulī prativāraṇa cā"ngulyaṃ vidhāyā"ngulireva ca evameva krameṇaiva varttayenmaṇḍalaṃ tataḥ śāligodhūmapiṣṭaiśca pañcarāgaṃ ca cūrṇakaiḥ tuṣā"ngārakacūrṇaiśca marakatasya ca cūrṇakaiḥ kesarasya tu mūle tu śuklavarṇaṃ prakīrtitam pūrvāyāṃ tu dalaṃ caiva śvetavarṇamiti smṛtam nairṛte dhūmravarṇaṃ tu vāruṇe mauktikaṃ bhavet aiśānyāṃ nīlamevaṃ tu dalavarṇamihocyate tadante rajanī yasya śālipiṣṭaṃ tadantake

ekahastaṃ dvihastaṃ vā caturhasta tathopi va hastau triṃśatibhirvāpi idamiddhanna kārayet aṣṭottaraśataṃ vāpi dalasaṃkhyā vidhīyate puruṣaṃ parvadale nyasya aghoraṃ dakṣiṇe dale āgneyyāṃ hṛdaye nyasya śiramīśānake dale kavacaṃ vāyudeśe tu netramīśānadeśake dainyake tu pade caiva śiṣyādivāsanaṃ bhavet brūhi me maṇḍalaṃ kuryāt evameva krameṇa tu prokṣayedambhasā caiva puṇyāhaṃ vācayettataḥ āvāhayettato devaṃ sadyojātena mantrataḥ sānnidhyaṃ puruṣeṇaiva īśānena tu pūjayet nivedayeccaruṃ tasya sarvopadaṃśasaṃyutam pātraśeṣaṃ caturthyantaṃ śataṃ śiṣyāya pradāpayet ācamya ca vidhānena dantairaspṛśya prāśayet dantakāṣṭhaṃ tataḥ kuryāddvādaśā"nguladairghyakam kṣīravṛkṣamapāmārgaṃ dantadhāvanamucyate śodhayitvā malaṃ vipra ācamya ca vidhānataḥ aghoramantreṇa bhasma śirasi vinyasettataḥ śivā"ngairbrahmabhiryuktaṃ japitvā paścāt prāśayet śiṣyaṃ cādhivasenmantrī maṇḍalasya tu dakṣiṇe agnikuṇḍaṃ prakartavyaṃ dvātriṃśatṣoḍaśaṃ tu vā vṛttaṃ vā caturaśraṃ vā sarvakuṇḍāni kārayet pālāśakhādirāśvatthapakṣanyagrodhameva ca samidājyacarūlājān śālīṃ ca sarṣapaṃ tathā samidhassadyamantreṇa ājyaṃ hṛdayameva ca

tilāṃ dhatte yamaṃ caiva śālīṃ ca puruṣeṇa tu śivāya daśa hotavyamavidye dviguṇaṃ bhavet triguṇaṃ lokapālāstraṃ homayeddeśikottamaḥ savastrān sāpidhānāṃśca samantrān hemasaṃhitān dhānyopari vidhātavyaṃ candanodakapūritam puruṣaṃ pūrvataḥ sthāpya aghoraṃ dakṣiṇena vā aiśānyāmīśamantreṇa āgneyyāṃ hṛdayena tu tattanmantrasamāyuktaṃ tattatkumbheṣu deśikaḥ hṛdayena tu mantreṇa naivedyān dāpayettataḥ padmaṃ puṣpaṃ ca vṛṣabhaṃ makuṭaṃ bhūmilābhakam dṛṣṭe mṛṣṭaphalaṃ caiva labhate'tra na saṃśayaḥ arpitaṃ phalitaṃ vāpi anyairvā śubhavṛkṣakaiḥ śālikṣetre mahatpakvaṃ dṛśyate śālilābhakam dṛśyate puṣpamālāyāṃ arthalābhaṃ vinirdiśet śārikāṃ vā bhayaṃ vāpi dṛśyet kuḍumbabandhanam patraṃ vā cārthalābhaṃ vā labhate'tra na saṃśayaḥ dātavyamapi svapne tu duḥkhanāśā bhavanti vai janaṃ vā vānaraṃ vāpi sarpaṃ vā dṛśyate'thavā prāsādarohaṇaṃ vāpi samudramuttīryate naraḥ candrasya maṇḍalaṃ dṛśye bhakṣaṇe vā viśeṣataḥ suraṃ vāpyasuraṃ vāpi pānaṃ vā dṛśyate yadi tarate sṛkniśī vāpi mahadarthamavāpnuyāt kṣīrapāne mahāvyādhirghṛtapāne mahadbhayam pāyasaṃ caiva vaiśvānaraṃ vā vāda līyate tataḥ śyenaṃ vā kapiṃ vāpi dhūrttaṃ caiva samūlakam

svadante patite caiva bandhurmaraṇamāpnuyāt te tu mahāvyādhi raktaṃ vā bhāmavāpnuyāt raktavastraiśca mālyairvā kṛṣṇaṃ vāpi ca dhāryate kathayukta rathāru * * * te tu yamālayam rūpe tu patite dṛśye maraṇaṃ tasya nirdiśet śai . . . . . cānyadvayaṃ vāpi raktasa(va)strāṃ suma"ngalīm tālavṛkṣaphalaṃ caiva phalānāṃ varjayettataḥ dhūrddhūrakaṃ vinā vipra śvetapuṣpaṃ pradṛśyate śukahastaṃ ca viprendra pakṣīṇāṃ tu pradarśayet svapne pradṛśyate vipra āyuṣyaṃ caiva vardhanam kadalī nālikeraṃ vā panasaṃ mātula"ngakam devānāṃ ca ṛṣīṇāṃ vā devapatnī ca vā sthirā āyaṃ cāhanaṃ vāpi dṛśyāt kuḍumbavardhanam ṛkṣāṃ vā taskaraṃ vāpi mahiṣaṃ vyāghrameva ca snānakāryaṃ prakuryāttu sadyo vyādhirvimucyate dhānyakṣayaṃ bhavettasya svapnānte'pi na saṃśayaḥ vāstu naśyati svāpānte arthahānimavāpnuyāt strībhissuma"ngalībhistu saṃyogaṃ maithunaṃ śubham sahasra paramāṃ devī śatamūlā śatā"nkurā idaṃ mantraṃ japitvā tu dūrvāṃ śirasi nikṣipet dvitīyena dvayaṃ caiva dviyāme caikavatsaram uṣāyāṃ tu daśāhe tu prāhe pañcadaśaṃ dinam evameva krameṇaiva svapnaṃ caiva parīkṣayet dīkṣāyā maṇḍalaṃ proktaṃ dīkṣāvidhimatha śṛṇu śaivāssaptavidhā ke vā tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho

tatsarvamakhilaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana tayostu saṃpuṭīkṛtya sā dīkṣā iti kathyate anādi śaivaṃ prathamaṃ ādiśaiva dvitīyakam avāntaraṃ tu śaivaṃ tu pañcamaṃ ca vidurbudhāḥ śaivāssapta tayā proktāsteṣāṃ bhedaṃ śṛṇuṣvathā śivadvijāśca viprendrā ādiśaivāḥ prakīrtitāḥ gautamaścāpyagastyaśca pañcavaktreṣu dīkṣitāḥ punardīkṣāṃ na kurvanti kartavyā cettu niṣphalam snapanaṃ cā"nga śuddhyarthaṃ kārayettu śivadvijān adīkṣitaścaturvedī śivapūjāṃ na kārayet ṣāṇmāsātpatanaṃ yāti yajeddevalaka smṛtāḥ pūjayedvṛti vipraistu sa vai devalako bhavet sthitali"nge tu yatpūjā na kurvīta kadācana śūdro'pyantara śaivastu ucyate kramaśo'dhunā pravara śaivamiti khyātamidamanya śṛṇuṣvathā ? ādiśaiva na kartavya pratiṣṭhā arcanāntakam śaivabhedaṃ mayā khyātaṃ dīkṣāvidhimatha śṛṇu puṣyaśśatabhiṣak caiva dīkṣānakṣatramucyate mithunaṃ vāpi kanyā vā dhanurvā mīnameva ca dvitīyā pañcamī vāpi ṣaṣṭhā vāpi viśeṣataḥ eteṣāṃ tithayaḥ proktā vārāṃścaiva śṛṇuṣvatha bṛhaspatyudayaṃ vāpi śukrodayamathāpi vā ? ṣaṣṭhasvaragṛhāṇāttu paścāt śiṣyāṃstu preṣitān pādaprakṣālanaṃ kuryādācamya ca vidhānataḥ dukūlapaṭṭasaṃyuktaṃ kārpāsikamathāpi vā

adhamaṃ navahastaṃ tu catustālaṃ tu vismṛtam sa daśāhatavastreṇa netre baddhaṃ tu kārayet vyomavyāpiṃ japettatra tatpuruṣeṇa samāyutam uttamaṃ daśaniṣkaṃ tu aṣṭaniṣkaṃ tu madhyamam daridrāṇāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ yathālābhena kārayet īśānena tu mantreṇa puṣpahaste nidhāpayet dhyātvā tu parameśānaṃ śivamantreṇa buddhimān yasminmantre padet puṣpaṃ nāmagotraṃ tu tanmatam īśānasya dale dvyādhirāgneyyāṃ śodhanaṃ tathā caturdikṣu ca viprendra tantrikāramiti smṛtam īśānasya dale caiva netrannāma mihocyate gandhādibhiryamabhyarcya hṛdayena tu mantrataḥ sasūtrān sāpidhānāṃśca savastrān hemasaṃyutān tasyodakena viprendra prokṣayet śiṣyamūrdhani aghoraṃ hṛdaye nyasya guhye vāmaṃ prakalpayet hṛdaye hṛdayaṃ nyasya śiraśśirasi vinyaset astraṃ hastapradeśe tu netraṃ netreṣu vinyaset kūrcenaiva samāyuktamāsanaṃ tatprakīrtitam agnibījena viprendra trikoṇamaṇḍale sthite amṛtena plāvayettatra ekacittena vai budhāḥ vidyātattvamukāraṃ tu śivatattvaṃ makārakam cintayedamṛtaṃ toyaṃ suṣumnābhinnaṃmastakam imāṃ yo'bhyasate nityaṃ samādhiṃ mṛtyunāśakam ṣaḍadhva vinyasetpaścāt śiṣyadehe viśeṣataḥ varṇādhvā ca kalādhvā ca viṃśatyekapadaṃ śivam

brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca īśvaraścāṣṭaśaktibhiḥ śiṣye dehe nyasedvipraḥ praṇavādi namo'ntakam mantrādhvā vinyasenmūrdhni kalādhvā mukhameva ca varṇādhvā meḍhradeśe tu pādayostu kalādhvakam sadyaṃ kalābhiraṣṭābhirvāmadevaṃ trayodaśa īśānasya kalāḥ pañca aṣṭatriṃśatkalā nyaset prāsādaṃ lokapālānāṃ astrāṇāṃ padamekaḥ pṛthivyāpastathā tejo vāyurākāśameva ca vākpāṇipādapāyūrupasthaṃ caiva tu pañcamam mano'haṃkārabuddhiśca prakṛtiḥ puruṣastathā vi * * * barakāśca śuddhamāyā tathaiva ca ṣaṭtriṃśatattvamevaṃ tu krameṇaiva tu vinyaset bhuvanādhvā nyasetpaścāt paścādūrdhvaṃ krameṇa tu kālāgniścāndhakāraṃ ta narako neka viṃśatiḥ kṣuradhārāsikādīni jalaṃ ca śītalena ca kūṭaṃ śālmali kūpaṃ ca tilayantreṣu yantrakam pāṣāṇaṃ taptapāṃsurvai dharaṇī ca tathaiva ca sutalaṃ ca talātalaṃ rasātalamathopari maharlokaśca vijñeyo janalokastathaiva ca vidyādharaṇāṃ lokaṃ ca siddhacāraṇalokakān indulokāgnilokaṃ ca yamo nirṛtilokakama īśānaṃ devalokaṃ ca brahmalokaṃ tathaiva ca ananteśasya lokaṃ tu sūkṣmalokamataḥparam ekarudrastrimūrtiśca śrīkaṇṭhaśca śikhaṇḍi ca lokaṃ ca śivalokaṃ ca kramameṣāṃ prakīrtitam

parivārāḥ kathaṃ devaṃ tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho parivāraṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāvidhipurassaram purato vṛṣabhasthānaṃ sthāpayedvṛṣabhaṃ tataḥ dakṣiṇe mātṛdevīṃśca vighneśaṃ nairṛte tathā jyeṣṭhāṃ vāyavyadeśe tu viṣṇuṃ cottaradeśataḥ evamantarahāre tu vinyasedaṣṭadaivatān paścime dvāradehasya paścime vṛṣabhaṃ nyaset uttarāyāṃ diśayoścaiva durgādevīṃ ca vinyaset pūrve tu bhāskarasthānaṃ kumāraṃ cāgnigocare mātṛsthānaṃ tu nairṛtyāṃ subrahmaṇyaṃ tu vāruṇe durgāṃ caṇḍeśa digbhāge bhāskaraṃ pūrvato nyaset uttaradvāragehasya uttare vṛṣabhālayam durgāmāgneya digbhāge yāmye mātṛgaṇā sthitāḥ vāyavyāṃ vinyasejjyeṣṭhāṃ viśeṣeṇa vicakṣaṇaḥ ṣoḍaśadvāradevāṃśca vakṣyāmi munisattama yamanairṛtayormadhye pitṛsthānaṃ vidhīyate varuṇavāyavyayormadhye ṛṣīṇāṃ sthānamucyate somīśānayormadhye aṣṭanāgān prakalpayet evameva prakāreṇa maryādau ca vidhiṃ nyaset indrādīn sthāpayedvipra pūrvādīśāntaṃ vinyaset evameva prakāreṇa parivārāṇi vinyaset dvāradevāṃ susaṃsthāpya pūrvādikramayogataḥ nandiṃ tu dakṣiṇe sthāpya kālaṃ cottaradeśake daṇḍiṃ tu paścime sthāpya muṇḍiṃ tu pūrvato nyaset bhṛ"ngiṇī cottare sthāpya dakṣiṇe vijayaṃ tathā

anantaṃ pūrvata sthāpya paśupatiṃ paścime nyaset vṛṣabhasyāgrato vāpi pṛṣṭhato'tha viśeṣataḥ * * * mamāvyādau va sthāpayettu śivāgrataḥ parivāravidhiḥ proktaṃ rakṣādīpaṃ śṛṇuṣvathā rakṣādīpaṃ kathaṃ devaṃ tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho rakṣādīpaṃ viśeṣeṇa trividhaṃ cocyate mayā sauvarṇaṃ rajataṃ vāpi tāmrajaṃ mṛṇmayaṃ tu vā pūrvaṃ ca dakṣiṇaṃ caiva paścimaṃ cottaraṃ tathā aṣṭabandhasamutsedhaṃ vistaraṃ dvādaśaṃ bhavet pādaṃ caiva daśā"ngulyamutsedhaṃ tu vidhīyate * * * * * saṃyojya rakṣādīpaṃ tu kārayet vistāraṃ tu caturviṃśat a"ngulā sthalikā bhavet teṣāmūrdhve tu * * * * * * * * * tathā nityanityārcane kuryāt tasyāṃ taddīpamucyate nityāgnikuṇḍaṃ viprendra * * * * * dīpayet sthālikāṃ vinyasettatra śikhāmantreṇa saṃyutam vartiṃ tatraiva vinyasya sannidhau dīpayettataḥ pūrṇena puruṣeṇaiva aghoraṃ dakṣiṇena tu vyomavyāpi sama * * pañcabrahmeṇa saṃyutam gaṇikāṃ devadāsī vā dhārayeddīpamuttamam sarvama"ngalasaṃyuktaṃ śa"nkhadhvanisamāyutam gacchetpradakṣiṇaṃ tatra ninayet śivasannidhau īśānena tu mantreṇa arcayeddīpameva ca ekaṃ vāpi trayaṃ vāpi pradakṣiṇamathācaret etat śāntikamityuktaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ ca matha śṛṇu

vinyaset sthālikāṃ tatra hṛdayena tu mantrataḥ garbhagehe sthite dīpe vartiṃ saṃyojayettataḥ hṛdayena tu mantreṇa dīpaṃ dadyāt śivasya tu visarjayettato mantrī bhasmaṃ śirasi nikṣipet evaṃ pauṣṭikamevaṃ tu kāmadaṃ śṛṇu tattvataḥ saptapātraika viprendra dīpaṃ saṃyojayettataḥ śive dīpaṃ susaṃyojya visarjayetpūrvavatkramāt uttamaṃ dīpamākhyātaṃ saptā"ngulasamucchrayam uttamaṃ goghṛtenaiva madhyamaṃ ajasaṃbhave dūrvākṣataiśca saṃyuktaṃ darpaṇaṃ bhasmameva ca dīpasya darśanaṃ mūrdhni śive dadyāt viśeṣataḥ yāntenaiva samāyuktaṃ ikārasvarasaṃyutam etanmantraṃ paraṃ guhyaṃ stavastrotraprakāśikam karaṇḍamakuṭaṃ yuktaṃ saumyarūpaṃ sulocanam evaṃvidhaṃ svarūpaṃ tu dhyātvā vai pūjayettataḥ ? balavikaraṇīṃ balapramathanīṃ sarvabhūtadamanīṃ manonmanīm madhye manonmanīṃ nyasya pūjayeddevabāhyataḥ evameva krameṇaiva svasvarnāmena pūjayet sāyāhne śayanaṃ kuryādevameva krameṇa tu sarvapāpairvinirmuktaśśivalokamavāpnuyāt a"nkurārpaṇaṃ kiṃ vā tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho tatsarvamakhilaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana utsavā"nkuramevoktaṃ tṛtīyaṃ tu viśeṣataḥ athā traya"nkuraṃ vidyāt dhvajā"nkuraṃ tu cocyate sthāpane prokṣaṇe yāge utsave snapane tathā

śrīkaraṃ śrīnivāsaṃ ca śrīpadaṃ ca tridhā bhavet kṛtvā navapadaṃ tatra devatāśca śṛṇuṣvatha dakṣiṇena yajurvedamākāśaṃ caiva nairṛte vāyavye pavanaṃ caiva atharvaṃ somake pade madhyame tu pade caiva somakumbhapratiṣṭhitam etat śrīkaramityuktaṃ śrīnivāsamatha śṛṇu ṣoḍaśātpādamevāhurdevatānāṃ śṛṇuṣvatha sugrīvo varuṇaśśeṣo mukhyassomoditastathā īśānaṃ caiva sugrīvo mukhyasya tu padāni ca jayanto vijayaścaiva varuṇo soma eva ca ādityaśca yamaścaiva śoṣaśca vādini sthitā etadvai śrīnivāsaṃ tu śrīpadaṃ ca śṛṇuṣvatha pañcaviṃśatpadaṃ kṛtvā pūjayetkramaśastathā bhṛ"ngaṃ ca mṛgasugrīvo varuṇaśśoṣamārutau āpa vatsārdha sāvitri vivasvāgnilamitrakaḥ brahmāṇaṃ ca pade caiva sthāpayet somakumbhakam pitṛdauvārikaścaiva mārutaścaiva mukhyakaḥ āpavatsādi devāṣṭau ghaṭikā sthānamucyate sauvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmraṃ mṛṇmayaṃ vāpi kārayet pālikāmukhavistāraṃ viṃśatya"ngulamuttamam vistāreṇa samotsedhaṃ tadardhaṃ pādavistaram madhyame bilasaṃyuktaṃ darpaṇodaravatkṛtam ghaṭikodara vistāraṃ dvādaśā"ngulamucyate pālikāpādavatkuryāt ghaṭilakṣaṇamucyate tadardhaṃ pādavistāraṃ tripādaṃ vā samucyate

ghaṭikā brahmadaivatyaṃ pālikā viṣṇurucyate caturviṃśatisaṃkhyāttu uttamaṃ tu vinirdiśet pālikā cāṣṭa vinyasya madhyamaṃ tadihocyate navame saptame vāpi pañcame taṃ yajetsadā grāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt triśūlena samāyutam tadante pālikādīni dhārayet śivabhaktakān suśuddhaṃ bhūtalaṃ prāpya prokṣayet śuddhavāriṇā kundāliṃ caiva saṃpūjya hṛdayena tu mantrataḥ mṛdaṃ saṃgrāhya vāmena hṛdīnā mṛdamarcayet prāsādasyograto vāpi īśāne dakṣiṇe tathā aṣṭadroṇena śālissyāt sthaṇḍilaṃ kārayettataḥ madhyame somakumbhaṃ tu vinyasetsomabījakaiḥ gandhapuṣpādinābhyarcya naivedyaṃ dāpayettataḥ darbheṇa suṣiraṃ nyasya mṛdaṃ tatraiva pūrayet puṇyāhaṃ tatra kurvīta tāmbūlaṃ dāpayettataḥ * * vaśipi saṃyuktaṃ apāmārgaṃ ca sarṣapam payasā kṣālayettatra hṛdayena tu mantrataḥ pāpayet śivamantreṇa * * * * stu vāpayet somādhidevatākumbhān abhiṣicya tato jalam suṣuptadeśe saṃsthāpya somakumbhena saṃyutam havirnivedayettatra tāmbūlaṃ dāpayettataḥ homayeccaiva viprendra apūpāni tathaiva ca a"nkurārpaṇahīne tu rājarāṣṭrasya doṣakṛt evaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaśśivaloke mahīyate tatsarvamakhilaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana

utgataṃ tutsavo yasmāt tasmādutsavamucyate jvara * māryāpravarttaṃ tu śatrupīḍaneṣu ca sarveṣāmiṣṭakāmārthaṃ sarvavyādhivināśanam dvividhaṃ utsavaṃ caiva tayorbhedaṃ śṛṇuṣvatha puṣyamāse tu puṣyāntaṃ māghamāse maghāntakam vaiśākhe tu viśākhāntaṃ mūlāntaṃ śreṣṭhamāsake pūrvāṣāḍhaṃ ca mevoktaṃ pūrvabhādreti māsake kṛttike kṛttikāntaṃ tu kārayettu śivotsavam kartuśca janmanakṣatre kuryādutsavamucyate śaivaṃ gauṇaṃ vibhūtaṃ ca bhauvanaṃ devikaṃ tathā eteṣāṃ bhedakaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana triyāhena samāyuktaṃ gauṇamityabhidhīyate navāhena samāyuktaṃ daivikaṃ utsavaṃ smṛtam śanaiścarasya vāre tu tathā kāmadamucyate eteṣāṃ tu krameṇaiva vakṣyate vidhinā'dhunā homaṃ kuryāttu tadrātrau bali bhramaṇamācaret aparedyuścaiva viprendra tīrthaṃ kuryāttu deśikaḥ triyaheṣu ca viprendra sāyaṃkāle samārabhet idamanyatprakāreṇa triyahaṃ vakṣyate'dhunā homaṃ kuryāttu tadrātrau tadrātrau balimārabhet balyante caiva viprendra cūrṇotsavaṃ tu kārayet pañcāhaṃ tu pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana homaṃ kuryāttu tadrātrau baliṃ caiva dadet punaḥ tīrthaṃ kuryādviśeṣeṇa idamanya śṛṇu ṣaṣṭhāhe tu ca pūrvāhṇe cūrṇotsavaṃ tu kārayet

sāyaṃkāle samārabhya pañcāhaṃ syāt dine tathā dvitīye ca tṛtīye ca caturthaṃ tu balidvayam kuryādvai tīrthakarmaṃ tu dvividhaṃ cocyate mayā aṣṭāhe caiva sāyāhne adhivāsanamārabhet caturdaśabaliṃ dadyāt cūrṇotsavaṃ tu kārayet saptāhe sāyamārabhya adhivāsya tato budhaḥ dvitīye divase caiva tṛtīye'pi caturthake saptāhaṃ balirekā syāt balyante cūrṇamucyate saptāhaṃ dvividhaṃ proktaṃ navāhaṃ ca śṛṇuṣvatha homaṃ kuryāttu tadrātrau baliṃ caiva tu dāpayet cūrṇotsavaṃ tataḥ kuryāt tīrthaṃ kuryāttate budhaḥ navāhe caiva sāyāhne adhivāsanamārabhet dvitīya divase caiva tṛtīye'pi caturthakam navāhe'pi ca viprendra daśāhe tu baliṃ kṣipet navāhe dvividhaṃ kuryāt procyate kamalāsana vārapūjāṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana puṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra havirnivedayettataḥ nityotsavasya kāle tu kuryāt grāmapradakṣiṇam praviśedālayaṃ tatra pādukārcanamucyate li"nge vā pratimāyāṃ vā tailābhya"ngamihocyate havirnivedayetpaścāt lokapālabaliṃ kṣipet grāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt sarvatodya samanvitam sāyaṃkālaṃ samārabhya prātaḥkāle baliṃ dadet maṇṭapāt dakṣiṇe pārśve sthāpayet kalaśaṃ nava samidājyacarūṃścaiva suhutvā pañcaviṃśatiḥ

baliṃ dadyāttu viprendra sāyaṃkāle viśeṣataḥ tīrthaṃ kuryāttato vidvān praviśedālayaṃ prati mārttāṇḍīyamidaṃ proktaṃ * māraṃ ca śṛṇu dvija samidājyacarūṃśvaiva * * * * * pūrvakam a"nkurānarpayedvidvān dhvajamāropayettataḥ dhvajamāropayet paścāt bherīṃ caiva tu tāḍayet bherīṃ tu tāḍayitvā tu dhvajamāropayettataḥ evameva krameṇaiva trividhaṃ cocyate mayā dviguṇīkṛtya vā kuryāddhvajamāropayettataḥ bhauvane daivike kuryādanyeṣu ca vivarjayet yaddineṣu prabhā kuryāt tatpūrve vā pare'pi vā nadīnada taṭākeṣu nakṣatre tīrthamucyate taddine saṃkramo bhāge divā tīrthaṃ ca niścayaḥ evameva krameṇaiva utsavaṃ kārayettataḥ prāsādasyāgrataḥ kuryāt maṇṭapaṃ caturaśrakam darbhamālābhirāveṣṭya puṣpamālāvalambitam lokapālādhidaivatyaṃ svasvarūpaṃ tu lāñcayet vitānenordhvamācchādya muktādāmairalaṃkṛtam mudgānnaṃ caiva dātavyaṃ upadaṃśa samanvitam aṣṭadroṇena śāliṃ tu tadardhaṃ taṇḍulairapi tasyopari nyasettatra kalaśānnavasaṃkhyayā pūrayet gandhatoyena svarṇaṃ tatra vinikṣipet pūrvādīśānaparyantaṃ vinyasedaṣṭakumbhakān ācamanaṃ dakṣiṇe tasya phalodakaṃ tu nairṛte uttare pañcagavyaṃ tu īśe ratnodakaṃ nyaset

vṛṣabhaṃ madhyame nyasya ukṣāṇaṃ pūrvato nyaset nairṛtyāṃ caiva nandī syāt paścime tu vaśet patim mahodaraṃ tu īśānyāṃ vinyaset kalaśeṣu ca aṣṭapatraṃ samālikhya darbhaiścaiva paristaret uttamaṃ daśahastaṃ tu madhyamaṃ navahastakam ardhādhike tritālaṃ tu paṭadairghya mihocyate ardhādhike tritālaṃ tu kanyastaṃ tviha cocyate brāhmaṇasya bhavet śvetaṃ kṣatriyasya tu raktakam vistāreṇa samaṃ pucchaṃ pucchārdhaṃ śikharaṃ bhavet vṛṣabhaṃ śvetavarṇaṃ tu raktavarṇaṃ tu śṛ"ngakam netre śvetamayī caiva madhyaraktamayī yathā paśudīpadvayo nyasya citramūrdhve tu vinyaset pūrvedyuradhivāsaṃ ca dhvajadaṇḍena saṃyutam gandhapuṣpādinā pūjya vṛṣagāyatrimantrataḥ tadante lokapālāṃśca pūjayettu viśeṣataḥ tasyaiva pūrvadigbhāge śālikā sthaṇḍilaṃ kuru tadūrdhve vinyasenmūlaṃ pūjayettu viśeṣataḥ kumāraṃ pālike nyasya kumbhe tu varuṇaṃ nyaset pīṭhe tu pārvatīṃ nyasya bhūmibhāge vasundarīm puṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra tāmbūlaṃ dāpayettataḥ śivāgnimānayettatra agnimukhaṃ ca hūyate pañcabrahmeṇa saṃyuktaṃ īśānādīni hūyate vṛṣāśivāsanaṃ proktaṃ dhvajārohaṇakaṃ śṛṇu śvetavarṇaṃ dhvajaṃ caiva rājarāṣṭra vivardhanam vijayaṃ kapilābhaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ caivābhicārakam

? dhānyān kāmānyakāmāya toṃ tāntānvai sādhayet dhvajaḥ śa"nkhasphaṭikamuktābhaṃ rakṣārthaṃ śāntipuṣṭikam rātrau vaiśyasya śūdrāṇāṃ vardhate kramaśastathā pīṭhagopurayormadhye vṛṣasya ca purato'pi vā kramukaṃ veṇudaṇḍaṃ ca candanaṃ vāpi khādiram avakraṃ nirvraṇaṃ caiva kṛmikoṭaravarjitam vṛṣabhasthala samaṃ vāpi gopurotsedhameva ca hastasaṃkhyena vā kuryāt triṃśaddhastamathāpi vā saptatriṃśā"ngulaṃ vāpi caturviṃśatireva vā veṇuyaṣṭiṃ tato grāhya avakraṃ nirvraṇaṃ tataḥ triparvaṃ vyādhinaṃ pīḍyaṃ catuṣparva vināśinaḥ saptaparvān gavāṃ nāśaḥ aṣṭaparvaistu vardhate ekādaśaṃ putrakāmaḥ dvādaśaṃ puṣṭikāmadam ṣaṭtālaṃ pañcatālaṃ vā tasyāgre ghaṭikāṃ nyaset hastamātrāntaraṃ jñeyaṃ hastaṃ vā suṣiradvayam agraghaṭikāmūlāntaṃ rajjudviguṇaṃ kārayet navavastraparīdhānā soṣṇīyaṃ cottarīyakam tasyānte cāstrarājānamannali"ngasamāyutam nānājanasamākīrṇaṃ nānāvādyasamāyutam ma"ngalā"nkurasamāyuktaṃ nṛttageyasamanvitam śanaiḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā dhvajasthānaṃ praverayet tasya mūle prakartavyaṃ vedilakṣaṇasaṃyutam puṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra prokṣayet śuddhavāriṇā darbhamālābhirāveṣṭya puṣpamālāsamanvitam utthāya dhvajadaṇḍaṃ tu vyomavyāpi samuccaran

tasya mūle prakartavyaṃ vedikālakṣaṇaṃ tataḥ vistaraḥ procyate vipra utsedhaṃ tu tadardhakam evamekhalamevaṃ syāt mekhalātrayameva ca adhastamekhalā caiva bhūmidevīṃ tu vinyaset trimekhaleṣu viprendra śaktīnāṃ traya kalpayet pūjayedgandhapuṣpeṇa dhūpadīpaissamanvitam puṇyāhaṃ kārayettatra kalaśān vinyasennavam indrādīśānaparyantaṃ vinyaset kalaśaṃ tataḥ snāpayitvā yathānyāyaṃ vṛṣayantrī ca mantrataḥ ? etatkāle tu pūjātīnāṃ piṇḍānyān bhojayettataḥ vṛṣagāyatrimantreṇa piṇḍaṃ dadyāttu deśikaḥ namaskāraṃ tu kartavyaṃ dhvajamūle samāśritaḥ anyajātistu sarveṣāṃ pratilomāśca kārayet tāmbūlaṃ dāpayettasmai janānsarvānviśeṣataḥ prātarmadhyāhnasāyāhne dhvajamāropayettataḥ lakṣaṇaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana vyadhavṛkṣeṇa vā kuryāt bherīṃ vā paṭahaṃ tu vā pañcatālaṃ tu madhyaṃ syāt ṣaḍa"ngulavihīnakam āyāmasya samaṃ nāhaṃ madhye paṭahamucyate evameva krameṇaiva kṛtvā paṭahamuttamam maddalaiḥ kāhalaiścaiva kāṃsyadhvanisamāyutam anyaiśca sarvavādyaiśca yathālābhena tāḍayet maṇṭapasya tu madhye tu gomayenānulepayet aṣṭadroṇena śālī syāt sthaṇḍilau dvau tu kārayet padmapatraṃ samālikhya darbhaiścaiva paristaret

paṭahaṃ vinyasettatra navavastrasamanvitam gandhaiḥ puṣpaiśca dhūpaiśca dīpaiścaruṃ nivedayet uttarābhimukho bhūtvā arcayedgandhapuṣpakaiḥ paṭahaṃ vinyasettatra hṛdayena tu pūjayet brahmāṇaṃ pūjayenmadhye evameva krameṇa tu mātarassanti kīle tu udare tu vyavasthitaḥ vādyakaṃ ca samāhūya sthānakarma samācaret nandikeśvaramāvāhya nandimantrasamanvitam paṭahasyaiva viprendra havirnivedayettataḥ vāmadevena mantreṇa arcayitvā viśeṣataḥ vādyakastāḍayetpaścāt nandimantreṇa saṃyutam carcapuṭaṃ tu brahmāṇaṃ cācapuṭa dvitīyake namāmi devīṃ varadāṃ sarasvatīm taṃtrāṇāmadbhavaṃ kiñcit tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho tanoti vipulānarthān tatvamantrasamāśritān kāmikaṃ yogajaṃ ciṃtyaṃ kāraṇaṃ tvajitaṃ tathā vijayañcaiva niśvāsaṃ svāyaṃbhuvamayānilam sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvavighnaharaṃ śubham aṣṭabandhaṃ tato hīne rājarāṣṭrasya doṣakṛt darśane bandhane hīne santānaṃ nāśayetkramāt baliṃ nityotsavañcaiva varjyaṃ prādakṣiṇaṃ tapam upacārāṇi sarvāṇi niṣphalañca tathā bhavet phālgune caivavaiśākhe puṣyamāte tu cottamaḥ varjayecānyamāteṣu viṣaye ca vihīnake dinavāramuhūrtañca varjayeddeśikottamaḥ
